environment.description: EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2, t3.medium) running the Flask monolith directly via gunicorn behind a classic ELB (no WAF). The instance IAM role has full DynamoDB access (dynamodb:*) on the UserSessions table with no condition keys. ELB passes all headers through without modification. No reverse proxy or header sanitization layer. Werkzeug version 2.0.3 which does NOT strip CRLF from header values.
